citations.claim: initial small angle -0.05 rad with margin 0.75 to limit
theta growing to -0.52 with controller saturated
theta -0.758 just before violation, omega -9.14 accelerating
pole angle violation -0.896 rad exceeds 0.8 limit

counterfactual.change: Set sensor_noise from 0.018 to 0, keeping all else same. Removes noisy feedback, controller stabilizes, no violation.

explanation: Noisy angle measurement with sensor_noise~0.018 causes controller to apply incorrect force, saturated at limit. Theta diverges from -0.05 to -0.89 in 18 steps (~0.26s). Counterfactual with sensor_noise=0 stays stable, proving noise+gain leads to instability.
vision_note: The pole starts slightly off upright and leans progressively farther in steps 15-17 while the cart stays near the track center and fails to bring it back. At step 18 the lean becomes large and the pole tip turns red, marking the pole_upright violation.
